using System.Text;

using MyImapDownloader.Imap;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Tests;

public sealed class TempDirectory : IDisposable
{
    public TempDirectory()
    {
        Path = System.IO.Path.Combine(System.IO.Path.GetTempPath(), $"downloader_tests_{Guid.NewGuid():N}");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path);
    }

    public string Path { get; }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.Delete(Path, recursive: true);
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
        }
    }
}

public sealed class ManualTimeProvider(DateTimeOffset now) : TimeProvider
{
    public DateTimeOffset Now { get; set; } = now;

    public override DateTimeOffset GetUtcNow() => Now;
}

public static class Eml
{
    public static byte[] Create(string? messageId, string subject = "Test subject", string body = "Hello world")
    {
        var builder = new StringBuilder();
        if (messageId is not null)
        {
            builder.Append($"Message-ID: <{messageId}>\r\n");
        }

        builder.Append("From: Sender <sender@example.com>\r\n");
        builder.Append("To: Receiver <receiver@example.com>\r\n");
        builder.Append($"Subject: {subject}\r\n");
        builder.Append("Date: Tue, 24 Dec 2024 10:30:00 +0000\r\n");
        builder.Append("MIME-Version: 1.0\r\n");
        builder.Append("Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\r\n");
        builder.Append("\r\n");
        builder.Append(body).Append("\r\n");
        return Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(builder.ToString());
    }
}

public sealed class FakeAuthenticationException() : Exception("Invalid credentials");

public sealed record FakeMessage(string? MessageId, string Subject, byte[] Content);

public sealed class FakeFolder(string fullName, uint uidValidity = 1) : IRemoteFolder
{
    public static readonly DateTimeOffset InternalDate = new(2024, 12, 24, 10, 30, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);

    public SortedDictionary<uint, FakeMessage> Messages { get; } = [];

    public Dictionary<uint, Exception> ReadFailures { get; } = [];

    public List<MessageWindow> Searches { get; } = [];

    public List<uint> Reads { get; } = [];

    public uint UidValidity { get; set; } = uidValidity;

    public string FullName => fullName;

    public FakeFolder Add(uint uid, string? messageId, string body = "Hello world")
    {
        var subject = $"Subject {uid}";
        Messages[uid] = new FakeMessage(messageId, subject, Eml.Create(messageId, subject, body));
        return this;
    }

    public Task<uint> OpenAsync(CancellationToken ct) => Task.FromResult(UidValidity);

    public Task<IReadOnlyList<uint>> FindAsync(MessageWindow window, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        Searches.Add(window);
        return Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyList<uint>>(Messages.Keys.Where(uid => uid > window.AfterUid).ToList());
    }

    public Task<IReadOnlyList<RemoteMessage>> DescribeAsync(IReadOnlyList<uint> uids, CancellationToken ct) =>
        Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyList<RemoteMessage>>(uids
            .Where(Messages.ContainsKey)
            .Select(uid => new RemoteMessage(uid, Messages[uid].MessageId, Messages[uid].Subject, InternalDate))
            .ToList());

    public Task<Stream> ReadAsync(uint uid, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        Reads.Add(uid);
        return ReadFailures.Remove(uid, out var failure)
            ? Task.FromException<Stream>(failure)
            : Task.FromResult<Stream>(new MemoryStream(Messages[uid].Content));
    }
}

public sealed class FakeMailServer : IMailServer, IMailSession
{
    public List<FakeFolder> Folders { get; } = [];

    public Queue<Exception> ConnectFailures { get; } = new();

    public int Connections { get; private set; }

    public int Disconnections { get; private set; }

    public Task<IMailSession> ConnectAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        Connections++;
        return ConnectFailures.TryDequeue(out var failure)
            ? Task.FromException<IMailSession>(failure)
            : Task.FromResult<IMailSession>(this);
    }

    public MailFailure Classify(Exception exception) => exception switch
    {
        FakeAuthenticationException => MailFailure.Authentication,
        IOException => MailFailure.Connection,
        _ => MailFailure.Message
    };

    public Task<IReadOnlyList<IRemoteFolder>> GetFoldersAsync(bool allFolders, CancellationToken ct) =>
        Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyList<IRemoteFolder>>(allFolders ? [.. Folders] : [.. Folders.Take(1)]);

    public ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        Disconnections++;
        return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
    }
}

using System.Text.Json;

using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using MyImapDownloader.Core.Storage;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Archive;

public sealed class ArchiveIndex : IAsyncDisposable
{
    public const string FileName = "index.v1.db";

    private const string Schema = """
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Messages (
            MessageId TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            Folder TEXT NOT NULL,
            ImportedAt TEXT NOT NULL
        );

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS SyncState (
            Folder TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            LastUid INTEGER NOT NULL,
            UidValidity INTEGER NOT NULL
        );

        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS IX_Messages_Folder ON Messages(Folder);
        """;

    private readonly SqliteConnection _connection;
    private readonly ILogger<ArchiveIndex> _logger;
    private readonly TimeProvider _time;

    private ArchiveIndex(SqliteConnection connection, ILogger<ArchiveIndex> logger, TimeProvider time)
    {
        _connection = connection;
        _logger = logger;
        _time = time;
    }

    public static async Task<ArchiveIndex> OpenAsync(
        string archiveRoot,
        ILogger<ArchiveIndex> logger,
        TimeProvider time,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(archiveRoot);
        var path = Path.Combine(archiveRoot, FileName);

        try
        {
            return new ArchiveIndex(await ConnectAsync(path, ct), logger, time);
        }
        catch (SqliteException exception) when (SqliteDatabase.IsCorruption(exception))
        {
            logger.LogError(exception, "Index database is corrupt. Rebuilding it from sidecar metadata.");
        }

        Quarantine(path, logger, time);
        var index = new ArchiveIndex(await ConnectAsync(path, ct), logger, time);
        try
        {
            await index.RebuildFromSidecarsAsync(archiveRoot, ct);
            return index;
        }
        catch
        {
            await index.DisposeAsync();
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task<bool> ContainsAsync(string messageId, CancellationToken ct) =>
        await _connection.ScalarAsync(
            "SELECT 1 FROM Messages WHERE MessageId = @id LIMIT 1", ct, [("@id", messageId)]) is not null;

    public Task RecordAsync(string messageId, string folder, CancellationToken ct) =>
        _connection.ExecuteAsync(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO Messages (MessageId, Folder, ImportedAt) VALUES (@id, @folder, @date)",
            ct,
            [("@id", messageId), ("@folder", folder), ("@date", _time.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime.ToString("O"))]);

    public async Task<long> GetLastUidAsync(string folder, long uidValidity, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        await using var command = _connection.Prepare(
            "SELECT LastUid, UidValidity FROM SyncState WHERE Folder = @folder", [("@folder", folder)]);
        await using var reader = await command.ExecuteReaderAsync(ct);

        if (!await reader.ReadAsync(ct))
        {
            return 0;
        }

        if (reader.GetInt64(1) == uidValidity)
        {
            return reader.GetInt64(0);
        }

        _logger.LogWarning("UIDVALIDITY changed for {Folder}. Resetting cursor.", folder);
        return 0;
    }

    public Task SetLastUidAsync(string folder, long lastUid, long uidValidity, CancellationToken ct) =>
        _connection.ExecuteAsync(
            """
            INSERT INTO SyncState (Folder, LastUid, UidValidity)
            VALUES (@folder, @uid, @validity)
            ON CONFLICT(Folder) DO UPDATE SET
                LastUid = @uid,
                UidValidity = @validity
            WHERE LastUid < @uid OR UidValidity != @validity;
            """,
            ct,
            [("@folder", folder), ("@uid", lastUid), ("@validity", uidValidity)]);

    public ValueTask DisposeAsync() => _connection.DisposeAsync();

    private static async Task<SqliteConnection> ConnectAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var connection = await SqliteDatabase.OpenAsync(path, ct);
        try
        {
            await connection.ExecuteAsync(Schema, ct);
            return connection;
        }
        catch
        {
            await connection.DisposeAsync();
            throw;
        }
    }

    private static void Quarantine(string path, ILogger logger, TimeProvider time)
    {
        var suffix = $".corrupt.{time.GetUtcNow().UtcTicks}";
        foreach (var file in (ReadOnlySpan<string>)[path, path + "-wal", path + "-shm"])
        {
            if (File.Exists(file))
            {
                File.Move(file, file + suffix);
                logger.LogWarning("Moved corrupt database file to {Path}", file + suffix);
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task RebuildFromSidecarsAsync(string archiveRoot, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Rebuilding index from disk...");
        var count = 0;

        await using var transaction = await _connection.BeginTransactionAsync(ct);
        foreach (var sidecar in Directory.EnumerateFiles(
            archiveRoot, "*" + MaildirStore.SidecarSuffix, SearchOption.AllDirectories))
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            try
            {
                await using var stream = File.OpenRead(sidecar);
                var metadata = await JsonSerializer.DeserializeAsync(
                    stream, EmailMetadataJsonContext.Default.EmailMetadata, ct);

                if (metadata is { MessageId.Length: > 0, Folder.Length: > 0 })
                {
                    await RecordAsync(metadata.MessageId, metadata.Folder, ct);
                    count++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception exception) when (exception is JsonException or IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Skipping malformed meta file {File}: {Error}", sidecar, exception.Message);
            }
        }

        await transaction.CommitAsync(ct);
        _logger.LogInformation("Recovery complete. Re-indexed {Count} emails.", count);
    }
}

using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Archive;

public static partial class ArchiveNaming
{
    private const int MaxMessageIdLength = 100;
    private const int MaxFolderLength = 100;
    private const int MaxHostLength = 20;

    public static string NormalizeMessageId(string messageId)
    {
        var cleaned = UnsafeMessageIdCharacters().Replace(messageId, "_").ToLowerInvariant();

        if (cleaned.Length > MaxMessageIdLength)
        {
            cleaned = $"{cleaned[..91]}_{Hash(cleaned)[..8]}";
        }

        return cleaned.Length == 0 ? "unknown" : cleaned;
    }

    public static string SafeFileId(string normalizedMessageId)
    {
        var invalid = Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars();
        var builder = new StringBuilder(normalizedMessageId.Length);
        foreach (var c in normalizedMessageId)
        {
            builder.Append(invalid.Contains(c) ? '_' : c);
        }

        return builder.ToString().TrimEnd('.', ' ');
    }

    public static string FolderDirectory(string folderName) => Sanitize(folderName, MaxFolderLength);

    public static string FileName(DateTimeOffset internalDate, string safeFileId, string hostName) =>
        $"{internalDate.ToUnixTimeSeconds()}.{safeFileId}.{Sanitize(hostName, MaxHostLength)}.eml";

    public static string Sanitize(string input, int maxLength)
    {
        var builder = new StringBuilder(maxLength);
        foreach (var c in input)
        {
            if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c is '-' or '_' or '.')
            {
                builder.Append(c);
            }
            else if (builder.Length > 0 && builder[^1] != '_')
            {
                builder.Append('_');
            }

            if (builder.Length >= maxLength)
            {
                break;
            }
        }

        return builder.ToString().Trim('_');
    }

    public static string Hash(string input) =>
        Convert.ToHexStringLower(SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(input)));

    public static async Task<string> HashFileAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        await using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
        return Convert.ToHexStringLower(await SHA256.HashDataAsync(stream, ct));
    }

    [GeneratedRegex("""[<>:"/\\|?*\x00-\x1F]""")]
    private static partial Regex UnsafeMessageIdCharacters();
}

using System.Diagnostics;

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using MimeKit;
using MimeKit.Utils;

using MyImapDownloader.Telemetry;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Archive;

public sealed class EmailArchive(
    ArchiveIndex index,
    MaildirStore store,
    ILogger<EmailArchive> logger,
    TimeProvider time) : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private const int MaxHeaderLength = 1024 * 1024;
    private static readonly ParserOptions HeaderParserOptions = new() { MaxHeaderLength = MaxHeaderLength };

    public static async Task<EmailArchive> OpenAsync(
        string root,
        ILoggerFactory loggers,
        TimeProvider time,
        string hostName,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var index = await ArchiveIndex.OpenAsync(root, loggers.CreateLogger<ArchiveIndex>(), time, ct);
        return new EmailArchive(index, new MaildirStore(root, hostName), loggers.CreateLogger<EmailArchive>(), time);
    }

    public Task<long> GetLastUidAsync(string folder, long uidValidity, CancellationToken ct) =>
        index.GetLastUidAsync(folder, uidValidity, ct);

    public Task SetLastUidAsync(string folder, long lastUid, long uidValidity, CancellationToken ct) =>
        index.SetLastUidAsync(folder, lastUid, uidValidity, ct);

    public Task<bool> ContainsAsync(string messageId, CancellationToken ct) =>
        index.ContainsAsync(ArchiveNaming.NormalizeMessageId(messageId), ct);

    public async Task<StoreOutcome> StoreAsync(
        Stream content,
        string? messageId,
        DateTimeOffset internalDate,
        string folderName,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var activity = DownloaderTelemetry.ActivitySource.StartActivity("SaveStream");
        var started = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();

        var id = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(messageId) ? null : ArchiveNaming.NormalizeMessageId(messageId);
        if (id is not null && await index.ContainsAsync(id, ct))
        {
            return new Duplicate(id);
        }

        var staged = await store.StageAsync(content, folderName, internalDate, ct);
        try
        {
            var headers = await ReadHeadersAsync(staged.Path, ct);

            if (id is null)
            {
                id = headers?[HeaderId.MessageId] is { } header && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(header)
                    ? ArchiveNaming.NormalizeMessageId(header)
                    : await ArchiveNaming.HashFileAsync(staged.Path, ct);

                if (await index.ContainsAsync(id, ct))
                {
                    store.Discard(staged);
                    return new Duplicate(id);
                }
            }

            var metadata = new EmailMetadata
            {
                MessageId = id,
                Subject = headers?[HeaderId.Subject],
                From = headers?[HeaderId.From],
                To = headers?[HeaderId.To],
                Date = DateUtils.TryParse(headers?[HeaderId.Date], out var sent)
                    ? sent.UtcDateTime
                    : internalDate.UtcDateTime,
                Folder = folderName,
                ArchivedAt = time.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime,
                HasAttachments = false
            };

            var committed = await store.CommitAsync(staged, id, metadata);
            await index.RecordAsync(id, folderName, CancellationToken.None);

            if (!committed.IsNew)
            {
                return new Duplicate(id);
            }

            DownloaderTelemetry.FilesWritten.Add(1);
            DownloaderTelemetry.BytesWritten.Add(staged.Length);
            DownloaderTelemetry.WriteLatency.Record(Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(started).TotalMilliseconds);

            return new Stored(id, committed.Path, staged.Length);
        }
        catch
        {
            store.Discard(staged);
            throw;
        }
    }

    public ValueTask DisposeAsync() => index.DisposeAsync();

    private async Task<HeaderList?> ReadHeadersAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try
        {
            await using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
            return await new MimeParser(HeaderParserOptions, stream, MimeFormat.Entity).ParseHeadersAsync(ct);
        }
        catch (FormatException exception)
        {
            logger.LogWarning(exception, "Could not parse headers of {Path}; archiving without header metadata", path);
            return null;
        }
    }
}

using System.Text.Json;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Archive;

public sealed record StagedMessage(string Path, string FolderPath, long Length, DateTimeOffset InternalDate);

public sealed record CommittedMessage(string Path, bool IsNew);

public sealed class MaildirStore(string root, string hostName)
{
    public const string SidecarSuffix = ".meta.json";

    private const int MaxNameAttempts = 1000;
    private static readonly string[] Subdirectories = ["cur", "new", "tmp"];

    public async Task<StagedMessage> StageAsync(
        Stream content,
        string folderName,
        DateTimeOffset internalDate,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var folderPath = Path.Combine(root, ArchiveNaming.FolderDirectory(folderName));
        foreach (var subdirectory in Subdirectories)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(folderPath, subdirectory));
        }

        var path = Path.Combine(folderPath, "tmp", $"{internalDate.ToUnixTimeSeconds()}.{Guid.NewGuid()}.tmp");
        try
        {
            await using var file = new FileStream(
                path, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None, 81920, FileOptions.Asynchronous);
            await content.CopyToAsync(file, ct);
            await file.FlushAsync(ct);
            file.Flush(flushToDisk: true);
            return new StagedMessage(path, folderPath, file.Length, internalDate);
        }
        catch
        {
            Discard(path);
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task<CommittedMessage> CommitAsync(StagedMessage staged, string messageId, EmailMetadata metadata)
    {
        var safeId = ArchiveNaming.SafeFileId(messageId);
        var directory = Path.Combine(staged.FolderPath, "cur");

        for (var attempt = 0; attempt < MaxNameAttempts; attempt++)
        {
            var fileId = attempt == 0 ? safeId : $"{safeId}_{attempt}";
            var path = Path.Combine(directory, ArchiveNaming.FileName(staged.InternalDate, fileId, hostName));

            if (TryMove(staged.Path, path))
            {
                await WriteSidecarAsync(path, staged.FolderPath, metadata);
                return new CommittedMessage(path, IsNew: true);
            }

            if (await HaveSameContentAsync(staged.Path, path))
            {
                await WriteSidecarAsync(path, staged.FolderPath, metadata);
                Discard(staged.Path);
                return new CommittedMessage(path, IsNew: false);
            }
        }

        throw new IOException($"No free file name for message '{messageId}' in '{directory}'.");
    }

    public void Discard(StagedMessage staged) => Discard(staged.Path);

    private static void Discard(string path)
    {
        try
        {
            File.Delete(path);
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
        }
    }

    private static bool TryMove(string source, string destination)
    {
        try
        {
            File.Move(source, destination, overwrite: false);
            return true;
        }
        catch (IOException) when (File.Exists(destination))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static async Task<bool> HaveSameContentAsync(string first, string second)
    {
        if (new FileInfo(first).Length != new FileInfo(second).Length)
        {
            return false;
        }

        return await ArchiveNaming.HashFileAsync(first, CancellationToken.None)
            == await ArchiveNaming.HashFileAsync(second, CancellationToken.None);
    }

    private static async Task WriteSidecarAsync(string emailPath, string folderPath, EmailMetadata metadata)
    {
        var sidecarPath = emailPath + SidecarSuffix;
        if (File.Exists(sidecarPath))
        {
            return;
        }

        var staging = Path.Combine(folderPath, "tmp", $"{Guid.NewGuid()}.meta.tmp");
        try
        {
            await using (var file = new FileStream(staging, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None))
            {
                await JsonSerializer.SerializeAsync(file, metadata, EmailMetadataJsonContext.Default.EmailMetadata);
                file.Flush(flushToDisk: true);
            }

            TryMove(staging, sidecarPath);
        }
        finally
        {
            Discard(staging);
        }
    }
}

using System.CommandLine;

namespace MyImapDownloader;

public static class DownloadCommand
{
    public const string PasswordVariable = "MYIMAPDOWNLOADER_PASSWORD";

    public static RootCommand Create(
        Func<DownloadOptions, CancellationToken, Task<int>> run,
        Func<string, string?>? environment = null)
    {
        Func<string, string?> variable = environment ?? Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable;

        var server = new Option<string>("--server", "-s") { Description = "IMAP server address", Required = true };
        var username = new Option<string>("--username", "-u") { Description = "Email username", Required = true };
        var password = new Option<string?>("--password", "-p")
        {
            Description = $"Email password (defaults to the {PasswordVariable} environment variable)"
        };
        var port = new Option<int>("--port", "-r") { Description = "IMAP port", DefaultValueFactory = _ => 993 };
        var output = new Option<string>("--output", "-o")
        {
            Description = "Output directory for archived emails",
            DefaultValueFactory = _ => "EmailArchive"
        };
        var startDate = new Option<DateTime?>("--start-date")
        {
            Description = "Download emails from this date (yyyy-MM-dd)"
        };
        var endDate = new Option<DateTime?>("--end-date")
        {
            Description = "Download emails until this date (yyyy-MM-dd)"
        };
        var allFolders = new Option<bool>("--all-folders", "-a")
        {
            Description = "Download from all folders, not just INBOX"
        };
        var verbose = new Option<bool>("--verbose", "-v") { Description = "Enable verbose logging" };

        var command = new RootCommand("Archive emails from an IMAP server to local .eml files")
        {
            server, username, password, port, output, startDate, endDate, allFolders, verbose
        };

        string? ResolvePassword(string? value) =>
            !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? value
            : variable(PasswordVariable) is { Length: > 0 } fallback ? fallback
            : null;

        command.Validators.Add(result =>
        {
            if (ResolvePassword(result.GetValue(password)) is null)
            {
                result.AddError($"Option '--password' is required unless {PasswordVariable} is set.");
            }
        });

        command.SetAction((parseResult, ct) => run(
            new DownloadOptions
            {
                Server = parseResult.GetRequiredValue(server),
                Username = parseResult.GetRequiredValue(username),
                Password = ResolvePassword(parseResult.GetValue(password))!,
                Port = parseResult.GetValue(port),
                OutputDirectory = parseResult.GetRequiredValue(output),
                StartDate = parseResult.GetValue(startDate),
                EndDate = parseResult.GetValue(endDate),
                AllFolders = parseResult.GetValue(allFolders),
                Verbose = parseResult.GetValue(verbose)
            },
            ct));

        return command;
    }

    public static ParseResult Parse(RootCommand command, IReadOnlyList<string> args) =>
        command.Parse(args, new ParserConfiguration { ResponseFileTokenReplacer = null });
}

namespace MyImapDownloader;

public sealed record DownloadOptions
{
    public required string Server { get; init; }
    public required string Username { get; init; }
    public required string Password { get; init; }
    public int Port { get; init; } = 993;
    public required string OutputDirectory { get; init; }
    public DateTime? StartDate { get; init; }
    public DateTime? EndDate { get; init; }
    public bool AllFolders { get; init; }
    public bool Verbose { get; init; }

    public bool HasDateWindow => StartDate is not null || EndDate is not null;
}

using System.Diagnostics;

using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using MyImapDownloader.Archive;
using MyImapDownloader.Core.Paths;
using MyImapDownloader.Core.Telemetry;
using MyImapDownloader.Imap;
using MyImapDownloader.Sync;
using MyImapDownloader.Telemetry;

namespace MyImapDownloader;

public static class DownloadSession
{
    private const int CancelledExitCode = 130;

    public static async Task<int> RunAsync(DownloadOptions options, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder()
            .SetBasePath(AppContext.BaseDirectory)
            .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json", optional: true, reloadOnChange: false)
            .AddEnvironmentVariables()
            .Build();

        var telemetryOptions = TelemetryOptions.From(
            configuration, DownloaderTelemetry.ServiceName, DownloaderTelemetry.ServiceVersion);

        using var telemetry = JsonFileTelemetry.Start(
            telemetryOptions, DownloaderTelemetry.ServiceName, XdgDirectories.Current);

        using var loggers = LoggerFactory.Create(logging =>
        {
            logging.AddConfiguration(configuration.GetSection("Logging"));
            logging.AddConsole();
            logging.SetMinimumLevel(options.Verbose ? LogLevel.Debug : LogLevel.Information);
            if (options.Verbose)
            {
                logging.AddFilter(null, LogLevel.Debug);
            }

            telemetry.ConfigureLogging(logging);
        });

        var logger = loggers.CreateLogger(typeof(DownloadSession));

        using var session = DownloaderTelemetry.ActivitySource.StartActivity("EmailArchiveSession", ActivityKind.Server);
        session?.SetTag("service.name", telemetryOptions.ServiceName);
        session?.SetTag("service.version", telemetryOptions.ServiceVersion);
        session?.SetTag("host.name", Environment.MachineName);
        session?.SetTag("process.pid", Environment.ProcessId);
        session?.SetTag("telemetry.directory", telemetry.OutputDirectory);

        var started = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        long ElapsedMilliseconds() => (long)Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(started).TotalMilliseconds;

        try
        {
            logger.LogInformation("Starting email archive download...");
            logger.LogInformation("Output: {Output}", Path.GetFullPath(options.OutputDirectory));
            logger.LogInformation("Telemetry output: {TelemetryOutput}", telemetry.OutputDirectory ?? "disabled");
            session?.AddEvent(new ActivityEvent("DownloadStarted"));

            await using var archive = await EmailArchive.OpenAsync(
                options.OutputDirectory, loggers, TimeProvider.System, Environment.MachineName, ct);

            var server = new MailKitMailServer(options, loggers.CreateLogger<MailKitMailServer>());
            var folders = new FolderSynchronizer(
                archive, server, loggers.CreateLogger<FolderSynchronizer>(), TimeProvider.System);
            var mailbox = new MailboxSynchronizer(server, folders, loggers.CreateLogger<MailboxSynchronizer>());

            await mailbox.RunAsync(options, ct);

            session?.SetTag("session_duration_ms", ElapsedMilliseconds());
            session?.SetStatus(ActivityStatusCode.Ok);
            session?.AddEvent(new ActivityEvent("DownloadCompleted"));
            logger.LogInformation("Archive complete! Session duration: {Duration}ms", ElapsedMilliseconds());
            return 0;
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            session?.SetStatus(ActivityStatusCode.Error, "Cancelled");
            session?.AddEvent(new ActivityEvent("DownloadCancelled"));
            logger.LogWarning("Download cancelled after {Duration}ms", ElapsedMilliseconds());
            return CancelledExitCode;
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            session.RecordError(exception);
            session?.AddEvent(new ActivityEvent("DownloadFailed"));
            logger.LogCritical(exception, "Fatal error during download");
            return 1;
        }
    }
}

using MailKit;
using MailKit.Net.Imap;
using MailKit.Search;
using MailKit.Security;

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using MyImapDownloader.Telemetry;

namespace MyImapDownloader;

public class EmailDownloadService
{
    private const int BatchSize = 50;

    private readonly ILogger<EmailDownloadService> _logger;
    private readonly ImapConfiguration _config;
    private readonly EmailStorageService _storage;
    private readonly AsyncRetryPolicy _retryPolicy;
    private readonly AsyncCircuitBreakerPolicy _circuitBreakerPolicy;

    public EmailDownloadService(
        ILogger<EmailDownloadService> logger,
        ImapConfiguration config,
        EmailStorageService storage)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _config = config;
        _storage = storage;

        _retryPolicy = Policy
            .Handle<Exception>(IsRetryable)
            .WaitAndRetryForeverAsync(
                retryAttempt => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Min(Math.Pow(2, retryAttempt), 300)),
                (exception, retryCount, timeSpan) =>
                {
                    DiagnosticsConfig.RetryAttempts.Add(1);
                    _logger.LogWarning(exception, "Retry {Count} in {Delay}: {Message}", retryCount, timeSpan, exception.Message);
                });

        _circuitBreakerPolicy = Policy
            .Handle<Exception>(IsRetryable)
            .CircuitBreakerAsync(5, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2));
    }

    private static bool IsRetryable(Exception ex) =>
        ex is not AuthenticationException and not OperationCanceledException;

    public async Task DownloadEmailsAsync(DownloadOptions options, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var activity = DiagnosticsConfig.ActivitySource.StartActivity("DownloadEmails");

        await _storage.InitializeAsync(ct);

        var policy = Policy.WrapAsync(_retryPolicy, _circuitBreakerPolicy);

        await policy.ExecuteAsync(async token =>
        {
            using var client = new ImapClient { Timeout = 180_000 };
            try
            {
                await ConnectAndAuthenticateAsync(client, token);

                var inbox = client.Inbox
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        "IMAP client returned a null Inbox after authentication.");

                var folders = options.AllFolders
                    ? await GetAllFoldersAsync(client, inbox, token)
                    : new List<IMailFolder> { inbox };

                foreach (var folder in folders)
                {
                    await ProcessFolderAsync(folder, options, token);
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                await DisconnectQuietlyAsync(client);
            }
        }, ct);
    }

    private async Task ProcessFolderAsync(IMailFolder folder, DownloadOptions options, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var activity = DiagnosticsConfig.ActivitySource.StartActivity("ProcessFolder");
        activity?.SetTag("folder", folder.FullName);

        try
        {
            await folder.OpenAsync(FolderAccess.ReadOnly, ct);

            var lastUid = await _storage.GetLastUidAsync(folder.FullName, folder.UidValidity, ct);

            _logger.LogInformation("Syncing {Folder}. Last UID: {Uid}", folder.FullName, lastUid);

            var query = SearchQuery.All;
            if (lastUid > 0)
            {
                var range = new UniqueIdRange(new UniqueId((uint)lastUid + 1), UniqueId.MaxValue);
                query = SearchQuery.Uids(range);
            }
            if (options.StartDate.HasValue) query = query.And(SearchQuery.DeliveredAfter(options.StartDate.Value));
            if (options.EndDate.HasValue) query = query.And(SearchQuery.DeliveredBefore(options.EndDate.Value));

            var uids = await folder.SearchAsync(query, ct);
            _logger.LogInformation("Found {Count} new messages in {Folder}", uids.Count, folder.FullName);

            var checkpoint = new FolderCheckpointTracker();

            for (var i = 0; i < uids.Count; i += BatchSize)
            {
                ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                var batch = uids.Skip(i).Take(BatchSize).ToList();
                var failedUids = await DownloadBatchAsync(folder, batch, checkpoint, ct);

                if (checkpoint.SafeCheckpoint > 0)
                {
                    await _storage.UpdateLastUidAsync(folder.FullName, checkpoint.SafeCheckpoint, folder.UidValidity, ct);
                }

                if (failedUids.Count > 0)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Failed to download {Count} emails in {Folder}: UIDs {Uids}",
                        failedUids.Count, folder.FullName, string.Join(", ", failedUids));
                }
            }

            if (checkpoint.LowestFailedUid.HasValue)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "Checkpoint for {Folder} held at UID {Checkpoint} so UID {Failed} is retried next run",
                    folder.FullName, checkpoint.SafeCheckpoint, checkpoint.LowestFailedUid.Value);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error processing folder {Folder}", folder.FullName);
            throw;
        }
    }

    private async Task<List<uint>> DownloadBatchAsync(
        IMailFolder folder,
        IList<UniqueId> uids,
        FolderCheckpointTracker checkpoint,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var failedUids = new List<uint>();

        var items = await folder.FetchAsync(uids, MessageSummaryItems.Envelope | MessageSummaryItems.UniqueId | MessageSummaryItems.InternalDate, ct);

        foreach (var item in items)
        {
            using var activity = DiagnosticsConfig.ActivitySource.StartActivity("ProcessEmail");

            var uid = item.UniqueId.Id;
            var envelope = item.Envelope;
            var envelopeMessageId = envelope?.MessageId;

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(envelopeMessageId))
            {
                var normalizedId = EmailStorageService.NormalizeMessageId(envelopeMessageId);
                if (await _storage.ExistsAsyncNormalized(normalizedId, ct))
                {
                    _logger.LogDebug("Skipping duplicate {Id}", normalizedId);
                    checkpoint.MarkProcessed(uid);
                    continue;
                }
            }

            Stream stream;
            try
            {
                stream = await folder.GetStreamAsync(item.UniqueId, ct);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException && !ImapConnectionFailure.IsConnectionLost(ex))
            {
                RecordFailure(ex, uid, failedUids, checkpoint);
                continue;
            }

            await using (stream)
            {
                try
                {
                    var isNew = await _storage.SaveStreamAsync(
                        stream,
                        envelopeMessageId ?? string.Empty,
                        item.InternalDate ?? DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
                        folder.FullName,
                        ct);

                    if (isNew)
                    {
                        DiagnosticsConfig.EmailsDownloaded.Add(1);
                        _logger.LogInformation("Downloaded: {Subject}", envelope?.Subject);
                    }

                    checkpoint.MarkProcessed(uid);
                }
                catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
                {
                    RecordFailure(ex, uid, failedUids, checkpoint);
                }
            }
        }

        return failedUids;
    }

    private void RecordFailure(Exception ex, uint uid, List<uint> failedUids, FolderCheckpointTracker checkpoint)
    {
        _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to download UID {Uid}", uid);
        failedUids.Add(uid);
        checkpoint.MarkFailed(uid);
    }

    private async Task ConnectAndAuthenticateAsync(ImapClient client, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Connecting to {Server}:{Port}", _config.Server, _config.Port);
        await client.ConnectAsync(_config.Server, _config.Port, SecureSocketOptions.SslOnConnect, ct);
        await client.AuthenticateAsync(_config.Username, _config.Password, ct);
    }

    private async Task DisconnectQuietlyAsync(ImapClient client)
    {
        if (!client.IsConnected) return;

        try
        {
            await client.DisconnectAsync(true, CancellationToken.None);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogDebug(ex, "IMAP disconnect failed");
        }
    }

    private static async Task<List<IMailFolder>> GetAllFoldersAsync(ImapClient client, IMailFolder inbox, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var folders = new List<IMailFolder>();

        if (client.PersonalNamespaces.Count > 0)
        {
            var personal = client.GetFolder(client.PersonalNamespaces[0]);
            await CollectFoldersRecursiveAsync(personal, folders, ct);
        }

        if (!folders.Contains(inbox))
        {
            folders.Insert(0, inbox);
        }

        return folders;
    }

    private static async Task CollectFoldersRecursiveAsync(IMailFolder parent, List<IMailFolder> folders, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        foreach (var folder in await parent.GetSubfoldersAsync(false, ct))
        {
            if (IsSelectable(folder))
            {
                folders.Add(folder);
            }

            await CollectFoldersRecursiveAsync(folder, folders, ct);
        }
    }

    private static bool IsSelectable(IMailFolder folder) =>
        (folder.Attributes & (FolderAttributes.NoSelect | FolderAttributes.NonExistent)) == 0;
}

using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using MimeKit;

using MyImapDownloader.Telemetry;

namespace MyImapDownloader;

public class EmailStorageService(ILogger<EmailStorageService> logger, string baseDirectory) : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private readonly string _dbPath = Path.Combine(baseDirectory, "index.v1.db");
    private SqliteConnection? _connection;

    public async Task InitializeAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(baseDirectory);

        try
        {
            await OpenAndMigrateAsync(ct);
        }
        catch (SqliteException ex)
        {
            logger.LogError(ex, "Database corruption detected. Initiating recovery...");
            await RecoverDatabaseAsync(ct);
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenAndMigrateAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        _connection = new SqliteConnection($"Data Source={_dbPath}");
        await _connection.OpenAsync(ct);

        using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
        cmd.CommandText = """
            PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;
            PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL;

            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Messages (
                MessageId TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                Folder TEXT NOT NULL,
                ImportedAt TEXT NOT NULL
            );

            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS SyncState (
                Folder TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                LastUid INTEGER NOT NULL,
                UidValidity INTEGER NOT NULL
            );

            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS IX_Messages_Folder ON Messages(Folder);
            """;

        await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct);
    }

    private async Task RecoverDatabaseAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (_connection != null)
        {
            await _connection.DisposeAsync();
            _connection = null;
        }

        SqliteConnection.ClearAllPools();

        var suffix = $".corrupt.{DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks}";
        foreach (var path in new[] { _dbPath, _dbPath + "-wal", _dbPath + "-shm" })
        {
            if (File.Exists(path))
            {
                File.Move(path, path + suffix);
                logger.LogWarning("Moved corrupt database file to {Path}", path + suffix);
            }
        }

        await OpenAndMigrateAsync(ct);

        logger.LogInformation("Rebuilding index from disk...");
        var count = 0;

        foreach (var metaFile in Directory.EnumerateFiles(baseDirectory, "*.meta.json", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
        {
            try
            {
                var json = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(metaFile, ct);
                var meta = JsonSerializer.Deserialize(json, EmailMetadataJsonContext.Default.EmailMetadata);
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(meta?.MessageId) &&
                    !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(meta.Folder))
                {
                    await InsertMessageRecordAsync(meta.MessageId, meta.Folder, ct);
                    count++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                logger.LogWarning("Skipping malformed meta file {File}: {Error}", metaFile, ex.Message);
            }
        }

        logger.LogInformation("Recovery complete. Re-indexed {Count} emails.", count);
    }

    public async Task<long> GetLastUidAsync(string folderName, long currentValidity, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (_connection == null) await InitializeAsync(ct);

        using var cmd = _connection!.CreateCommand();
        cmd.CommandText = "SELECT LastUid, UidValidity FROM SyncState WHERE Folder = @folder";
        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@folder", folderName);

        using var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync(ct);
        if (await reader.ReadAsync(ct))
        {
            var storedValidity = reader.GetInt64(1);
            if (storedValidity == currentValidity)
                return reader.GetInt64(0);

            logger.LogWarning("UIDVALIDITY changed for {Folder}. Resetting cursor.", folderName);
        }

        return 0;
    }

    public async Task UpdateLastUidAsync(string folderName, long lastUid, long validity, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var cmd = _connection!.CreateCommand();
        cmd.CommandText = """
            INSERT INTO SyncState (Folder, LastUid, UidValidity)
            VALUES (@folder, @uid, @validity)
            ON CONFLICT(Folder) DO UPDATE SET
                LastUid = @uid,
                UidValidity = @validity
            WHERE LastUid < @uid OR UidValidity != @validity;
            """;

        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@folder", folderName);
        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@uid", lastUid);
        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@validity", validity);
        await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct);
    }

    public async Task<bool> SaveStreamAsync(
        Stream networkStream,
        string messageId,
        DateTimeOffset internalDate,
        string folderName,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var activity = DiagnosticsConfig.ActivitySource.StartActivity("SaveStream");
        var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();

        var normalizedId = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(messageId) ? null : NormalizeMessageId(messageId);

        if (normalizedId != null && await ExistsAsyncNormalized(normalizedId, ct))
            return false;

        var folderPath = GetFolderPath(folderName);
        EnsureMaildirStructure(folderPath);

        var tempPath = Path.Combine(
            folderPath,
            "tmp",
            $"{internalDate.ToUnixTimeSeconds()}.{Guid.NewGuid()}.tmp");

        try
        {
            long bytesWritten;
            using (var fs = File.Create(tempPath))
            {
                await networkStream.CopyToAsync(fs, ct);
                bytesWritten = fs.Length;
            }

            HeaderList headers;
            using (var fs = File.OpenRead(tempPath))
            {
                var parser = new MimeParser(fs, MimeFormat.Entity);
                headers = await parser.ParseHeadersAsync(ct);
            }

            if (normalizedId == null)
            {
                var parsedId = headers[HeaderId.MessageId];
                normalizedId = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parsedId)
                    ? NormalizeMessageId(parsedId)
                    : await ComputeFileHashAsync(tempPath, ct);

                if (await ExistsAsyncNormalized(normalizedId, ct))
                {
                    File.Delete(tempPath);
                    return false;
                }
            }

            var metadata = new EmailMetadata
            {
                MessageId = normalizedId,
                Subject = headers[HeaderId.Subject],
                From = headers[HeaderId.From],
                To = headers[HeaderId.To],
                Date = DateTimeOffset.TryParse(headers[HeaderId.Date], out var d)
                    ? d.UtcDateTime
                    : internalDate.UtcDateTime,
                Folder = folderName,
                ArchivedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                HasAttachments = false
            };

            var safeFileId = SanitizeFilename(normalizedId);
            var finalName = GenerateFilename(internalDate, safeFileId);
            var finalPath = Path.Combine(folderPath, "cur", finalName);

            var attempt = 0;
            while (File.Exists(finalPath) && attempt < 10)
            {
                attempt++;
                finalName = GenerateFilename(internalDate, $"{safeFileId}_{attempt}");
                finalPath = Path.Combine(folderPath, "cur", finalName);
            }

            if (File.Exists(finalPath))
            {
                File.Delete(tempPath);
                await InsertMessageRecordAsync(normalizedId, folderName, ct);
                return false;
            }

            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(finalPath)!);
            File.Move(tempPath, finalPath);

            await File.WriteAllTextAsync(
                finalPath + ".meta.json",
                JsonSerializer.Serialize(metadata, EmailMetadataJsonContext.Default.EmailMetadata),
                ct);

            await InsertMessageRecordAsync(normalizedId, folderName, ct);

            DiagnosticsConfig.FilesWritten.Add(1);
            DiagnosticsConfig.BytesWritten.Add(bytesWritten);
            DiagnosticsConfig.WriteLatency.Record(sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds);

            return true;
        }
        catch
        {
            try { if (File.Exists(tempPath)) File.Delete(tempPath); } catch { }
            throw;
        }
    }

    private async Task InsertMessageRecordAsync(string messageId, string folder, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var cmd = _connection!.CreateCommand();
        cmd.CommandText =
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO Messages (MessageId, Folder, ImportedAt) VALUES (@id, @folder, @date)";
        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", messageId);
        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@folder", folder);
        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@date", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("O"));
        await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct);
    }

    private string GetFolderPath(string folderName) =>
        Path.Combine(baseDirectory, SanitizeForFilename(folderName, 100));

    private static void EnsureMaildirStructure(string folderPath)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(folderPath, "cur"));
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(folderPath, "new"));
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(folderPath, "tmp"));
    }

    public static string GenerateFilename(DateTimeOffset date, string safeId)
    {
        var host = SanitizeForFilename(Environment.MachineName, 20);
        return $"{date.ToUnixTimeSeconds()}.{safeId}.{host}.eml";
    }

    public static string NormalizeMessageId(string messageId)
    {
        var cleaned = Regex.Replace(messageId, @"[<>:""/\\|?*\x00-\x1F]", "_")
            .Trim('<', '>')
            .ToLowerInvariant();

        if (cleaned.Length > 100)
        {
            var hash = ComputeHash(cleaned)[..8];
            cleaned = cleaned[..91] + "_" + hash;
        }

        return cleaned.Length == 0 ? "unknown" : cleaned;
    }

    private static string SanitizeFilename(string input)
    {
        var invalid = Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars();
        var sb = new StringBuilder(input.Length);

        foreach (var c in input)
            sb.Append(invalid.Contains(c) ? '_' : c);

        return sb.ToString().TrimEnd('.', ' ');
    }

    public async Task<bool> ExistsAsyncNormalized(string id, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var cmd = _connection!.CreateCommand();
        cmd.CommandText = "SELECT 1 FROM Messages WHERE MessageId = @id LIMIT 1";
        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", id);
        return (await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync(ct)) != null;
    }

    public static string SanitizeForFilename(string input, int maxLength)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder(maxLength);
        foreach (var c in input)
        {
            if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c is '-' or '_' or '.')
                sb.Append(c);
            else if (sb.Length > 0 && sb[^1] != '_')
                sb.Append('_');

            if (sb.Length >= maxLength) break;
        }
        return sb.ToString().Trim('_');
    }

    public static string ComputeHash(string input)
    {
        var bytes = SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(input));
        return Convert.ToHexString(bytes).ToLowerInvariant();
    }

    private static async Task<string> ComputeFileHashAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var fs = File.OpenRead(path);
        var bytes = await SHA256.HashDataAsync(fs, ct);
        return Convert.ToHexString(bytes).ToLowerInvariant();
    }

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        if (_connection != null)
            await _connection.DisposeAsync();
    }
}

namespace MyImapDownloader;

public sealed class FolderCheckpointTracker
{
    private long _safeCheckpoint;
    private long? _lowestFailedUid;

    public long SafeCheckpoint => _safeCheckpoint;

    public long? LowestFailedUid => _lowestFailedUid;

    public void MarkProcessed(uint uid)
    {
        if (_lowestFailedUid is null || uid < _lowestFailedUid)
        {
            _safeCheckpoint = Math.Max(_safeCheckpoint, uid);
        }
    }

    public void MarkFailed(uint uid)
    {
        if (_lowestFailedUid is null || uid < _lowestFailedUid)
        {
            _lowestFailedUid = uid;
        }

        if (_safeCheckpoint >= _lowestFailedUid)
        {
            _safeCheckpoint = _lowestFailedUid.Value - 1;
        }
    }
}

using System.Net.Sockets;

using MailKit;
using MailKit.Net.Imap;
using MailKit.Search;
using MailKit.Security;

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Imap;

public sealed class MailKitMailServer(DownloadOptions options, ILogger<MailKitMailServer> logger) : IMailServer
{
    private const int TimeoutMilliseconds = 180_000;

    public async Task<IMailSession> ConnectAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var client = new ImapClient { Timeout = TimeoutMilliseconds };
        try
        {
            logger.LogInformation("Connecting to {Server}:{Port}", options.Server, options.Port);
            await client.ConnectAsync(options.Server, options.Port, SecureSocketOptions.SslOnConnect, ct);
            await client.AuthenticateAsync(options.Username, options.Password, ct);
            return new Session(client, logger);
        }
        catch
        {
            client.Dispose();
            throw;
        }
    }

    public MailFailure Classify(Exception exception) => exception switch
    {
        AuthenticationException => MailFailure.Authentication,
        IOException or SocketException or TimeoutException or ProtocolException
            or ServiceNotConnectedException or FolderNotOpenException => MailFailure.Connection,
        _ => MailFailure.Message
    };

    private sealed class Session(ImapClient client, ILogger logger) : IMailSession
    {
        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<IRemoteFolder>> GetFoldersAsync(bool allFolders, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            var inbox = client.Inbox;
            List<IMailFolder> folders = [];

            if (allFolders && client.PersonalNamespaces.Count > 0)
            {
                await CollectAsync(client.GetFolder(client.PersonalNamespaces[0]), folders, ct);
            }

            if (!folders.Contains(inbox))
            {
                folders.Insert(0, inbox);
            }

            return folders.ConvertAll<IRemoteFolder>(folder => new Folder(folder));
        }

        public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                if (client.IsConnected)
                {
                    await client.DisconnectAsync(true, CancellationToken.None);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                logger.LogDebug(exception, "IMAP disconnect failed");
            }
            finally
            {
                client.Dispose();
            }
        }

        private static async Task CollectAsync(IMailFolder parent, List<IMailFolder> folders, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            foreach (var folder in await parent.GetSubfoldersAsync(false, ct))
            {
                if ((folder.Attributes & (FolderAttributes.NoSelect | FolderAttributes.NonExistent)) == 0)
                {
                    folders.Add(folder);
                }

                await CollectAsync(folder, folders, ct);
            }
        }
    }

    private sealed class Folder(IMailFolder folder) : IRemoteFolder
    {
        private const MessageSummaryItems SummaryItems =
            MessageSummaryItems.Envelope | MessageSummaryItems.UniqueId | MessageSummaryItems.InternalDate;

        public string FullName => folder.FullName;

        public async Task<uint> OpenAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        {
            await folder.OpenAsync(FolderAccess.ReadOnly, ct);
            return folder.UidValidity;
        }

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<uint>> FindAsync(MessageWindow window, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            var query = window.AfterUid > 0
                ? SearchQuery.Uids(new UniqueIdRange(new UniqueId(window.AfterUid + 1), UniqueId.MaxValue))
                : SearchQuery.All;

            if (window.DeliveredAfter is { } after)
            {
                query = query.And(SearchQuery.DeliveredAfter(after));
            }

            if (window.DeliveredBefore is { } before)
            {
                query = query.And(SearchQuery.DeliveredBefore(before));
            }

            var uids = await folder.SearchAsync(query, ct);
            return uids.Select(uid => uid.Id).Where(id => id > window.AfterUid).Order().ToList();
        }

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<RemoteMessage>> DescribeAsync(IReadOnlyList<uint> uids, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            var summaries = await folder.FetchAsync(
                uids.Select(uid => new UniqueId(uid)).ToList(), new FetchRequest(SummaryItems), ct);

            return summaries
                .Select(summary => new RemoteMessage(
                    summary.UniqueId.Id,
                    summary.Envelope?.MessageId,
                    summary.Envelope?.Subject,
                    summary.InternalDate))
                .ToList();
        }

        public Task<Stream> ReadAsync(uint uid, CancellationToken ct) => folder.GetStreamAsync(new UniqueId(uid), ct);
    }
}

namespace MyImapDownloader.Imap;

public enum MailFailure
{
    Message,
    Connection,
    Authentication
}

public readonly record struct MessageWindow(uint AfterUid, DateTime? DeliveredAfter, DateTime? DeliveredBefore);

public sealed record RemoteMessage(uint Uid, string? MessageId, string? Subject, DateTimeOffset? InternalDate);

public interface IMailServer
{
    Task<IMailSession> ConnectAsync(CancellationToken ct);

    MailFailure Classify(Exception exception);
}

public interface IMailSession : IAsyncDisposable
{
    Task<IReadOnlyList<IRemoteFolder>> GetFoldersAsync(bool allFolders, CancellationToken ct);
}

public interface IRemoteFolder
{
    string FullName { get; }

    Task<uint> OpenAsync(CancellationToken ct);

    Task<IReadOnlyList<uint>> FindAsync(MessageWindow window, CancellationToken ct);

    Task<IReadOnlyList<RemoteMessage>> DescribeAsync(IReadOnlyList<uint> uids, CancellationToken ct);

    Task<Stream> ReadAsync(uint uid, CancellationToken ct);
}

using System.Net.Sockets;

using MailKit;

namespace MyImapDownloader;

/// <summary>
/// Classifies exceptions that indicate the IMAP connection is no longer usable.
/// </summary>
public static class ImapConnectionFailure
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns true when the exception means the connection was lost and the session must reconnect,
    /// as opposed to a failure specific to a single message.
    /// </summary>
    public static bool IsConnectionLost(Exception ex) => ex is
        IOException or
        SocketException or
        TimeoutException or
        ProtocolException or
        ServiceNotConnectedException or
        FolderNotOpenException;
}

  Last git commit:       6c251f2 2026-11-15 14:56:29 -0500 add claude response

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using MyImapDownloader.Archive;
using MyImapDownloader.Imap;
using MyImapDownloader.Telemetry;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Sync;

public sealed class FolderSynchronizer(
    EmailArchive archive,
    IMailServer server,
    ILogger<FolderSynchronizer> logger,
    TimeProvider time)
{
    private const int BatchSize = 50;

    public async Task SyncAsync(IRemoteFolder folder, DownloadOptions options, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var activity = DownloaderTelemetry.ActivitySource.StartActivity("ProcessFolder");
        activity?.SetTag("folder", folder.FullName);

        try
        {
            var uidValidity = await folder.OpenAsync(ct);
            var useCursor = !options.HasDateWindow;
            var lastUid = useCursor ? await archive.GetLastUidAsync(folder.FullName, uidValidity, ct) : 0;

            logger.LogInformation("Syncing {Folder}. Last UID: {Uid}", folder.FullName, lastUid);

            var uids = await folder.FindAsync(new MessageWindow((uint)lastUid, options.StartDate, options.EndDate), ct);
            logger.LogInformation("Found {Count} new messages in {Folder}", uids.Count, folder.FullName);

            var checkpoint = new FolderCheckpointTracker();

            foreach (var batch in uids.Chunk(BatchSize))
            {
                ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                var failed = await DownloadBatchAsync(folder, batch, checkpoint, ct);

                if (useCursor && checkpoint.SafeCheckpoint > 0)
                {
                    await archive.SetLastUidAsync(
                        folder.FullName, checkpoint.SafeCheckpoint, uidValidity, CancellationToken.None);
                }

                if (failed.Count > 0)
                {
                    logger.LogWarning(
                        "Failed to download {Count} emails in {Folder}: UIDs {Uids}",
                        failed.Count, folder.FullName, string.Join(", ", failed));
                }
            }

            if (checkpoint.LowestFailedUid is { } lowestFailed)
            {
                logger.LogWarning(
                    "Checkpoint for {Folder} held at UID {Checkpoint} so UID {Failed} is retried next run",
                    folder.FullName, checkpoint.SafeCheckpoint, lowestFailed);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (exception is not OperationCanceledException)
        {
            logger.LogError(exception, "Error processing folder {Folder}", folder.FullName);
            throw;
        }
    }

    private async Task<List<uint>> DownloadBatchAsync(
        IRemoteFolder folder,
        IReadOnlyList<uint> uids,
        FolderCheckpointTracker checkpoint,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        List<uint> failed = [];

        foreach (var message in await folder.DescribeAsync(uids, ct))
        {
            using var activity = DownloaderTelemetry.ActivitySource.StartActivity("ProcessEmail");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message.MessageId) && await archive.ContainsAsync(message.MessageId, ct))
            {
                logger.LogDebug("Skipping duplicate {Id}", message.MessageId);
                checkpoint.MarkProcessed(message.Uid);
                continue;
            }

            if (await TryDownloadAsync(folder, message, ct))
            {
                checkpoint.MarkProcessed(message.Uid);
            }
            else
            {
                failed.Add(message.Uid);
                checkpoint.MarkFailed(message.Uid);
            }
        }

        return failed;
    }

    private async Task<bool> TryDownloadAsync(IRemoteFolder folder, RemoteMessage message, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        Stream content;
        try
        {
            content = await folder.ReadAsync(message.Uid, ct);
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (
            exception is not OperationCanceledException && server.Classify(exception) != MailFailure.Connection)
        {
            logger.LogError(exception, "Failed to download UID {Uid}", message.Uid);
            return false;
        }

        await using (content)
        {
            try
            {
                var outcome = await archive.StoreAsync(
                    content, message.MessageId, message.InternalDate ?? time.GetUtcNow(), folder.FullName, ct);

                if (outcome is Stored)
                {
                    DownloaderTelemetry.EmailsDownloaded.Add(1);
                    logger.LogInformation("Downloaded: {Subject}", message.Subject);
                }

                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception exception) when (exception is not OperationCanceledException)
            {
                logger.LogError(exception, "Failed to download UID {Uid}", message.Uid);
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using MyImapDownloader.Imap;
using MyImapDownloader.Telemetry;

using Polly;
using Polly.Retry;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Sync;

public sealed class MailboxSynchronizer
{
    private const double MaxBackoffSeconds = 300;

    private readonly IMailServer _server;
    private readonly FolderSynchronizer _folders;
    private readonly ILogger<MailboxSynchronizer> _logger;
    private readonly ResiliencePipeline _pipeline;

    public MailboxSynchronizer(
        IMailServer server,
        FolderSynchronizer folders,
        ILogger<MailboxSynchronizer> logger,
        Func<int, TimeSpan>? backoff = null)
    {
        _server = server;
        _folders = folders;
        _logger = logger;

        var delay = backoff ?? Backoff;
        _pipeline = new ResiliencePipelineBuilder()
            .AddRetry(new RetryStrategyOptions
            {
                MaxRetryAttempts = int.MaxValue,
                ShouldHandle = arguments => ValueTask.FromResult(
                    arguments.Outcome.Exception is { } exception && IsRetryable(exception)),
                DelayGenerator = arguments => ValueTask.FromResult<TimeSpan?>(delay(arguments.AttemptNumber)),
                OnRetry = arguments =>
                {
                    DownloaderTelemetry.RetryAttempts.Add(1);
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        arguments.Outcome.Exception,
                        "Retry {Count} in {Delay}: {Message}",
                        arguments.AttemptNumber + 1,
                        arguments.RetryDelay,
                        arguments.Outcome.Exception?.Message);
                    return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
                }
            })
            .Build();
    }

    public static TimeSpan Backoff(int attempt) =>
        TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Min(Math.Pow(2, attempt + 1), MaxBackoffSeconds));

    public async Task RunAsync(DownloadOptions options, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var activity = DownloaderTelemetry.ActivitySource.StartActivity("DownloadEmails");

        await _pipeline.ExecuteAsync(
            async token =>
            {
                await using var session = await _server.ConnectAsync(token);
                foreach (var folder in await session.GetFoldersAsync(options.AllFolders, token))
                {
                    await _folders.SyncAsync(folder, options, token);
                }
            },
            ct);
    }

    private bool IsRetryable(Exception exception) =>
        exception is not OperationCanceledException && _server.Classify(exception) != MailFailure.Authentication;
}

using System.Diagnostics;

namespace MyImapDownloader.Telemetry;

/// <summary>
/// Extension methods for Activity to provide RecordException functionality
/// that works across OpenTelemetry versions.
/// </summary>
public static class ActivityExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Records an exception as an event on the activity with standard attributes.
    /// </summary>
    public static void RecordException(this Activity? activity, Exception exception)
    {
        if (activity == null || exception == null) return;

        var tags = new ActivityTagsCollection
        {
            ["exception.type"] = exception.GetType().FullName,
            ["exception.message"] = exception.Message,
        };

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(exception.StackTrace))
        {
            tags["exception.stacktrace"] = exception.StackTrace;
        }

        activity.AddEvent(new ActivityEvent("exception", tags: tags));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the activity status to error with the exception message.
    /// </summary>
    public static void SetErrorStatus(this Activity? activity, Exception exception)
    {
        if (activity == null || exception == null) return;

        activity.SetStatus(ActivityStatusCode.Error, exception.Message);
        activity.RecordException(exception);
    }
}

# MyImapDownloader

[![Build and Test](https://github.com/kusl/MyImapDownloader/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/kusl/MyImapDownloader/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
![.NET 11](https://img.shields.io/badge/.NET-11.0-512BD4)
[![License: AGPL v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-AGPL%20v3-blue.svg)](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0)

Two .NET 11 CLI tools:

- **MyImapDownloader** archives IMAP mailboxes to local `.eml` files with delta sync.
- **MyEmailSearch** indexes the archive into SQLite FTS5 and searches it.

> This project contains code generated by LLMs. Treat it as experimental.

## Safety

- IMAP folders are opened with `FolderAccess.ReadOnly`. No delete, move or flag commands exist.
- Archived `.eml` files are never overwritten or deleted. The only local deletion is cleanup of the downloader's own staging files in `tmp/`.
- The search index is derived data and can be rebuilt at any time.

## Install

Build from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/kusl/MyImapDownloader.git
cd MyImapDownloader
dotnet build -c Release
```

`global.json` accepts .NET SDK `11.0.100-rc.3` or any newer 11.0 SDK. CI builds and releases with the latest GA SDK.

Or install the latest self-contained Linux release to `/opt` with wrappers in `/usr/local/bin`:

```bash
bash install.sh
```

`install.sh` preserves an existing `appsettings.json`.

## MyImapDownloader

```bash
myimapdownloader -s imap.example.com -u you@example.com -p "app-password" -o ~/Documents/mail/you_example_com -a
```

| Option | Alias | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--server` | `-s` | required | IMAP server |
| `--username` | `-u` | required | Username |
| `--password` | `-p` | `$MYIMAPDOWNLOADER_PASSWORD` | Password or app password. Required unless the environment variable is set; the variable keeps the secret out of the process list |
| `--port` | `-r` | `993` | Port (implicit TLS) |
| `--output` | `-o` | `EmailArchive` | Archive directory |
| `--all-folders` | `-a` | `false` | All selectable folders instead of INBOX only |
| `--start-date` | | | Only messages delivered after this date (`yyyy-MM-dd`) |
| `--end-date` | | | Only messages delivered before this date (`yyyy-MM-dd`) |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `false` | Debug logging |
| `--help`, `--version` | `-h` | | |

Arguments starting with `@` are passed through literally; response files are disabled.

Exit codes: `0` success, `1` failure or invalid arguments, `130` cancelled (Ctrl+C or SIGTERM; up to 30 s is allowed to flush state).

### Archive layout

```
<output>/
├── index.v1.db
└── INBOX/
    ├── cur/
    │   ├── 1702900000.abc123@mail.example.com.myhost.eml
    │   └── 1702900000.abc123@mail.example.com.myhost.eml.meta.json
    ├── new/
    └── tmp/
```

File names are `{internal-date-unix}.{normalized-message-id}.{host}.eml`. Messages are written to `tmp/`, flushed to disk and moved to `cur/` without ever replacing an existing file. The sidecar is written the same way.

If the target name already exists with identical content (for example after a crash between the move and the index update), the existing file is adopted and a missing sidecar is restored. If the content differs, the new message is stored with a `_1`, `_2`, ... suffix on the message id.

Messages without a `Message-ID` header are identified by the SHA-256 of their content.

`index.v1.db` (SQLite, WAL):

```sql
CREATE TABLE Messages (MessageId TEXT PRIMARY KEY, Folder TEXT NOT NULL, ImportedAt TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE SyncState (Folder TEXT PRIMARY KEY, LastUid INTEGER NOT NULL, UidValidity INTEGER NOT NULL);
```

Sidecar `.meta.json`:

```json
{
  "MessageId": "abc123@mail.example.com",
  "Subject": "Project Update",
  "From": "alice@example.com",
  "To": "bob@example.com",
  "Date": "2025-12-24T10:30:00Z",
  "Folder": "INBOX",
  "ArchivedAt": "2025-12-24T15:45:32Z",
  "HasAttachments": false
}
```

`HasAttachments` is currently always `false`. Header fields are `null` when the headers cannot be parsed; the message is archived regardless.

### Delta sync

1. Read `LastUid`/`UidValidity` for the folder. A changed `UIDVALIDITY` resets the cursor to 0.
2. Search `UID > LastUid`.
3. Fetch envelopes in batches of 50 and skip Message-IDs already in `Messages`.
4. Stream each new message to disk.
5. After each batch, advance `LastUid` to the highest UID below the lowest failed UID in this folder run. Failed messages are retried on the next run.

A message that fails on its own (expunged, rejected by the server, local write error) is recorded as failed and the batch continues. A lost connection (I/O error, timeout, protocol error, disconnected client or closed folder) ends the attempt instead, so the session reconnects rather than failing every remaining message in the batch.

With `--start-date` or `--end-date` the run searches the whole date window instead, relies on Message-ID deduplication and leaves `LastUid` untouched, so a windowed run can never make a later full run skip older mail.

Session attempts are retried with exponential backoff (2 s doubling to a 5 minute cap). Each retry opens a new connection and resumes every folder from its saved `LastUid`. Authentication errors and cancellation are not retried.

### Recovery

If `index.v1.db` is corrupt or not a SQLite database, it and its `-wal`/`-shm` files are renamed to `*.corrupt.<ticks>`, a new database is created and `Messages` is rebuilt from all `.meta.json` files. `SyncState` restarts at 0; existing messages are skipped by Message-ID. Other errors, such as a database locked by a second running instance, are reported and never trigger recovery.

### Configuration

`appsettings.json` next to the binary; environment variables override it (`Telemetry__EnableMetrics=false`).

```json
{
  "Telemetry": {
    "ServiceName": "MyImapDownloader",
    "ServiceVersion": "1.0.0",
    "MaxFileSizeMB": 25,
    "EnableTracing": true,
    "EnableMetrics": true,
    "EnableLogging": true,
    "FlushIntervalSeconds": 5,
    "MetricsExportIntervalSeconds": 15
  },
  "Logging": {
    "LogLevel": { "Default": "Information", "Microsoft": "Warning", "System": "Warning" }
  }
}
```

### Telemetry

OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs are written as JSONL to the first writable directory of:

1. `$XDG_STATE_HOME/myimapdownloader/telemetry`
2. `$XDG_DATA_HOME/myimapdownloader/telemetry`
3. `~/.local/state/myimapdownloader/telemetry`
4. `~/.local/share/myimapdownloader/telemetry`
5. `./telemetry`

If none is writable, telemetry is disabled.

Files: `{traces|metrics|logs}/{kind}_{yyyyMMdd}_{seq:D4}.jsonl`, rotated daily and at `MaxFileSizeMB`. Properties are PascalCase and null values are omitted; tag and attribute values are strings.

Spans: `EmailArchiveSession`, `DownloadEmails`, `ProcessFolder`, `ProcessEmail`, `SaveStream`.

| Metric | Type | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `emails.downloaded` | Counter | emails |
| `retry.attempts` | Counter | attempts |
| `storage.files.written` | Counter | files |
| `storage.bytes.written` | Counter | bytes |
| `storage.write.latency` | Histogram | ms |

.NET runtime metrics (the built-in `System.Runtime` meter) are also exported.

## MyEmailSearch

The archive root is expected to contain one directory per account, each holding MyImapDownloader output:

```
~/Documents/mail/<account>/<folder>/cur/*.eml
```

```bash
myemailsearch index --content
myemailsearch search "from:alice@example.com subject:report kafka"
myemailsearch search "date:2025-01-01..2025-06-30 invoice" --format json --limit 50
myemailsearch status
myemailsearch rebuild --yes --content
```

Global options, valid before or after the subcommand:

| Option | Alias | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--archive` | `-a` | Archive root |
| `--database` | `-d` | Index database file |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | Debug logging |

| Command | Options |
|---|---|
| `search <query>` | `--limit/-l` (100), `--format/-f` `table\|json\|csv` (anything else is rejected), `--open/-o` |
| `index` | `--full/-f`, `--content` |
| `status` | |
| `rebuild` | `--yes/-y`, `--content` |

Without `--content`, only subject, sender and recipients are full-text indexed; a 500-character preview is always stored.

Query syntax:

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `from:addr` | Exact sender, case-insensitive; `*` is a wildcard |
| `to:addr` | Recipient contains |
| `subject:text` or `subject:"two words"` | Subject contains |
| `date:YYYY-MM-DD` or `date:YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD` | Sent date range, end inclusive |
| `after:YYYY-MM-DD`, `before:YYYY-MM-DD` | Bounds, `before` inclusive |
| `account:name`, `folder:name` | Exact account or folder directory |
| remaining text | FTS5 phrase; trailing `*` for prefix match |

A term is only recognised at the start of a word, and quoted values may contain other terms (`subject:"from:x"`). The first occurrence of each term wins; repeats and invalid dates are searched as text.

Defaults:

- Archive: `$MYIMAPDOWNLOADER_ARCHIVE`, then `$XDG_DATA_HOME/myimapdownloader`, `~/.local/share/myimapdownloader`, `~/Documents/mail`, `~/mail`.
- Database: `$XDG_DATA_HOME/myemailsearch/search.db`, else `~/.local/share/myemailsearch/search.db`.

Indexing is incremental by file path and modification time. `rebuild` drops and recreates the index tables. Indexes created by earlier versions are used as they are. Logs go to stderr, so `--format json` and `csv` output on stdout is clean. `search` exits `1` when no index exists.

## Development

```
MyImapDownloader.Core/         XDG paths, SQLite connection helper, JSONL telemetry
MyImapDownloader/
  Archive/                     On-disk layout: naming, maildir store, SQLite index
  Imap/                        Mail server port and its MailKit adapter
  Sync/                        Delta sync per folder, retrying session
MyEmailSearch/
  Commands/                    CLI commands and output formatting
  Data/                        SQLite FTS5 index
  Indexing/                    Archive scan and MIME parsing
  Search/                      Query parsing, search, snippets
*.Tests/                       TUnit tests
Directory.Packages.props       Central package versions
```

```bash
dotnet build
dotnet test
```

| Package | Use |
|---|---|
| MailKit / MimeKit.Core | IMAP and MIME parsing |
| Microsoft.Data.Sqlite | SQLite and FTS5 |
| System.CommandLine | CLI parsing |
| Polly.Core | Retry |
| OpenTelemetry | Traces, metrics, logs |
| TUnit | Tests |

JSON serialization uses source-generated `JsonSerializerContext`s and configuration binding uses the binder source generator. The sync logic depends on `IMailServer`, so it is tested against an in-memory server; only `MailKitMailServer` talks to the network.

See [docs/net11-migration.md](docs/net11-migration.md) for what changed in the .NET 11 rewrite.
